source.title: Tasi - Fairy of Dreams
source.name: Tasi
source.description: A lively and agile Mage, skilled at inflicting control effects on multiple enemies.

skills.name: Eternal Dreamscape

description.raw: Tasi summons a dream that lasts for 3.5 + 0.5 (SP-based)s, hypnotizing all enemies. Hypnotized enemies cannot move or act and take 70% (ATK-based) + 12% (SP-based) damage per second.
active: Tasi summons a dream that lasts for 3.5 + 0.5 (SP-based)s, hypnotizing all enemies.
Hypnotized enemies cannot move or act and take 70% (ATK-based) + 12% (SP-based) damage per second.

skills.description_lite: Tasi summons a dream to hypnotize all enemies, causing them to take damage each second.

skills.name: Dream Dance

description.raw: Tasi consumes 10% of her current HP to deal damage equal to 110% + 10% (SP-based) of her consumed HP to adjacent enemies, stunning them for 0.5s. The damage dealt will be no less than 60% (ATK-based). She then flies to the farthest enemy and applies the same effect to adjacent enemies. However, the second hit on the same enemy will deal only 50% of the original damage.
active: Tasi consumes 10% of her current HP to deal damage equal to 110% + 10% (SP-based) of her consumed HP to adjacent enemies, stunning them for 0.5s.
The damage dealt will be no less than 60% (ATK-based).
She then flies to the farthest enemy and applies the same effect to adjacent enemies.
However, the second hit on the same enemy will deal only 50% of the original damage.

text: Increases damage to 120% + 10% (SP-based) of her consumed HP.
Increases damage to 130% + 10% (SP-based) of her consumed HP.
Increases damage to 140% + 10% (SP-based) of her consumed HP.

skills.description_lite: Tasi consumes HP to deal damage and stun nearby enemies, then flies to a distant enemy to deal damage and stun again.

skills.name: Fluttering Dream

description.raw: Tasi enters her dream realm and transforms into a butterfly upon losing 50% (HP-based) HP. In this form, she becomes invincible, recovering 120% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) HP per second while dealing 45% (ATK-based) + 5% (SP-based) damage to adjacent enemies. This effect lasts for 3s, and Tasi can cast this skill up to 2 times in one battle.
active: Tasi enters her dream realm and transforms into a butterfly upon losing 50% (HP-based) HP.
In this form, she becomes invincible, recovering 120% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) HP per second while dealing 45% (ATK-based) + 5% (SP-based) damage to adjacent enemies.
This effect lasts for 3s, and Tasi can cast this skill up to 2 times in one battle.

skills.description_lite: Tasi transforms into a butterfly when she loses a certain amount of HP. In this form, she recovers HP while dealing damage to nearby enemies.

skills.name: Hero Focus

description.raw: Tasi increases her ATK by 9% during battle. After casting Eternal Dreamscape, she gains an extra 6% ATK while the dream lasts.
active: Tasi increases her ATK by 9% during battle.
After casting Eternal Dreamscape, she gains an extra 6% ATK while the dream lasts.

text: Tasi increases her ATK by 12% during battle.
After casting Eternal Dreamscape, she gains an extra 8% ATK while the dream lasts.
Tasi increases her ATK by 15% during battle.
After casting Eternal Dreamscape, she gains an extra 10% ATK while the dream lasts.

skills.description_lite: Tasi increases her ATK and gains an additional increase while Eternal Dreamscape is active.

skills.name: Shimmering Dust

description.raw: Tasi gains 70 Haste and reduces damage taken by 90% for 5s after casting Eternal Dreamscape. During this time, Dream Dance no longer costs Tasi's HP to cast and has no cooldown. Its damage counts as if Tasi had consumed 10% of her current HP, and she will prioritize targeting the farthest hypnotized enemy.
active: Tasi gains 70 Haste and reduces damage taken by 90% for 5s after casting Eternal Dreamscape.
During this time, Dream Dance no longer costs Tasi's HP to cast and has no cooldown.
Its damage counts as if Tasi had consumed 10% of her current HP, and she will prioritize targeting the farthest hypnotized enemy.

text: Gains 100 Haste after casting Eternal Dreamscape.
Adds 40 extra Penetration when dealing damage to hypnotized enemies with Dream Dance.
Gains 130 Haste after casting Eternal Dreamscape.

skills.description_lite: Tasi gains Haste and reduces damage taken after casting Eternal Dreamscape. Additionally, she can cast Dream Dance more quickly.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: Tasi gains an extra attempt to cast Fluttering Dream each time she assists or kills a non-summoned enemy.
active: Tasi gains an extra attempt to cast Fluttering Dream each time she assists or kills a non-summoned enemy.

skills.description_lite: Tasi gains an extra attempt to cast Fluttering Dream each time she assists or defeats an enemy.
